---
title: "Staff Portal Access"
toc: false
---

Access to CloudCore's internal documentation and staff directory is limited
to authorised project teams. Enter the access details provided by your unit
coordinator.

```{=html}
<div class="card" style="max-width: 26rem; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 2rem;">
<form id="unit-gate-form">
<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
<label for="unit-gate-code" style="display:block; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:.4rem;">Unit Code</label>
<input type="text" id="unit-gate-code" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. ISYS6018" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" spellcheck="false" required>
</div>
<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
<label for="unit-gate-password" style="display:block; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:.4rem;">Access Password</label>
<div class="cc-pwd-wrap">
<input type="password" id="unit-gate-password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password" required>
<button type="button" id="toggle-unit-gate-password" class="cc-pwd-toggle" aria-label="Show password"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg></button>
</div>
</div>
<div style="margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
<label for="unit-gate-badge" style="display:block; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:.4rem;">Contractor Badge ID</label>
<input type="text" id="unit-gate-badge" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. CC-4XKQ-9M2T" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" spellcheck="false" required>
<small style="color:#64748b;">Your badge determines which office&rsquo;s hours you log in under &mdash; Perth or Mauritius.</small>
</div>
<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="width:100%;">Enter Portal</button>
<p id="unit-gate-error" style="color:#dc2626; margin-top:.75rem; min-height:1.25rem;"></p>
</form>
</div>
```

<small>Trouble signing in? Contact your unit coordinator. Sessions last the
teaching period on this browser.</small>
